# DAMO-YOLO-M

Object Detection · `damoyolo-m_640x640` · DX-APP C++ example

Object Detection model, evaluated on COCO 2017.

**Input** 640 × 640 × 3 · **Dataset** COCO 2017 · **License** Apache-2.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![DAMO-YOLO-M output](../../../../python_example/object_detection/damoyolo/damoyolo-m_640x640/result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](../../../../python_example/object_detection/damoyolo/damoyolo-m_640x640/model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models DamoYoloM
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target damoyolo-m_640x640_sync   # once
./bin/damoyolo-m_640x640_sync \
  -m assets/models/damoyolo-m_640x640.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/object_detection/damoyolo/damoyolo-m_640x640/damoyolo-m_640x640_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/damoyolo-m_640x640.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 48.36 |
| Q-Lite | 48.18 (−0.18) |
| Q-Pro | 48.16 (−0.20) |

COCO 2017 · difference vs Raw in brackets.
